values.note: $29 a night in the reservation season (double site $58); $18.75 in the first-come season after it (2026: Sept 27 - Nov 14). One vehicle included; extra vehicles $8 a night.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232368/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-26: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 29, double 58, WALK TO 29; First-come, First-served Season 2026-09-27 to 2026-11-14: 18.75, double 37.50; 2027 the same) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/peaceful-valley-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night'; 'Double Site: $58 per night') + recreation.gov notice ('Any additional vehicles will be charged $8.00 per vehicle per night'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/peaceful-valley-campground ('There is no electricity, hook-ups, dump stations, or showers.') + recreation.gov notice ('No RV water connections are available. Utility hookups are not available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Nine RV-suitable sites, eight better for tents; 14x16-ft tent pads with bear lockers. Catalogued RV spurs: 007 45 ft, 003/004 40, 002/009/015/016/017 35, 001 32, 005/006 25 (all back-in); 010-014 are walk-to. Site 17 is oversized (up to 12 people per the FS; 10 per recreation.gov). Paved campground roads; every vehicle must fit on its spur.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232368 ('There are 17 sites in the campground. Nine are suitable for RV camping and eight are more suitable for tents.'; 'The maximum vehicle length that can be accommodated is 45 feet'; 'The roads in the campground are paved') + catalog 232368 (Max Vehicle Length per site as listed; 010-014 WALK TO) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/peaceful-valley-campground ('There are 17 sites'; 'Tents must be confined to the provided 14' X 16' tent pad'; 'unit 17, which can accommodate up to 12 people'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: One hand pump for drinking water, accessible vault toilets, trash, bear lockers, picnic table, fire ring and grill at each site; firewood for sale. Nearest showers 12 miles away at Meeker Park Lodge.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232368 ('There is one hand pump with potable water, trash dumpsters, vault toilets and firewood is for sale'; notice 'the nearest showers are 12 miles away, at Meeker Park Lodge') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/peaceful-valley-campground ('Picnic tables, fire grates, water, vault toilets, bear locker and trash services are provided'; 'no electricity, hook-ups, dump stations, or showers'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232368/rates (Peak Season ends 2026-09-26, then 'First-come, First-served Season' 2026-09-27 to 2026-11-14; notice 'Sites may be available on a first-come, first-served basis outside of the reservation season'); neither page states an opening or closing date, read 2026-10-28

values.note: Sites 1-7 and 9 are reservable on recreation.gov at least four days ahead; 8 and 10-17 are first-come. Two-night weekend and three-night holiday-weekend minimums; 14 nights in a rolling 60 days. A reserved site not occupied within 26 hours goes to first-come. Reservation season 2026 May 15 - Sept 26 (2027: May 14 - Sept 25), then first-come only.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/peaceful-valley-campground ('Campsites 8 and 10-17 are first come, first served. Campsites 1-7 and 9 are reservable.'; '14-day stay limit') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232368 (rules reservationCutOff 4, minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days'; notice 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours') + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-26, 2027-05-14 to 2027-09-25), read 2026-10-28

note: Boulder Ranger District campground in a flat glacial valley beside Middle St. Vrain Creek (fly fishing), 1/4 mile up Middle Saint Vrain Road (CR 92 / FSR 114) off CO-72, ~6.5 miles north of Ward, 8,500 ft; mixed conifer and aspen with open grass. Sourdough and Buchanan Pass trails nearby; Camp Dick is just up the road. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov + catalog: confirmed max 45 ft, $29 (in season) / $18.75 (first-come season), no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov. Waterfront re-audit lead (stored creekside, not changed): FS 'adjacent to Middle St. Vrain Creek'; recreation.gov 'on the banks of the Middle Saint Vrain Creek', amenity 'Creek Access'. No catalog site carries a Proximity to Water tag. On Esri imagery with the site points, the creek runs in a wooded gully along the east edge: sites 1-4 are ~25-40 m from it behind a band of trees, 7 is ~30 m from the road bridge; the west sites (10-17) are 100 m+ away. Under the open-apron rule the creekside value looks doubtful (riverview/not waterfront more likely for the east sites).

Season: stored season.closes 09-26 was derived from the recreation.gov availability calendar, i.e. the end of the reservation season. recreation.gov's rate table has a first-come season Sept 27 - Nov 14 (2026), so the campground stays open past 09-26; no published closing date. Set to null; reservation season recorded under booking.season.
Site 008 is missing from recreation.gov's catalog (FS: first-come). Site 17 capacity: FS 12 people, recreation.gov 10.

Pin 40.13139,-105.50611 (recreation.gov facility point) is ~71 m from the 17 site points' centroid (40.13164,-105.50687), ~38 m from the nearest site. OK. The FS coordinate 40.13174,-105.50447 is ~140 m east at the entrance road.
Length: recreation.gov states the 45-ft maximum outright and site 007 catalogues 45 (real, not a 60/99 placeholder); 8 of 9 RV sites take 25 ft+, 6 take 35 ft+.
